title: Conversation Topics
description: A conversation record capturing derived conversation signals, including a topic taxonomy classification. Record-based (time-invariant) so it can be composed into a schema and used as a lookup/reference dataset.

xdm:topic.title: Topic
xdm:topic.description: Topic classification derived for the conversation.

xdm:taxonomy.title: Topic Taxonomy
xdm:taxonomy.description: Denormalized topic taxonomy levels, from the top-level (level1) root down to the deepest level.

xdm:level1.title: Topic Level 1
xdm:level1.description: The highest-level (root) parent topic in the taxonomy.

xdm:level2.title: Topic Level 2
xdm:level2.description: The second-level topic, a child of level1.

xdm:level3.title: Topic Level 3
xdm:level3.description: The third-level topic, a child of level2.

xdm:level4.title: Topic Level 4
xdm:level4.description: The fourth-level topic, a child of level3.

xdm:level5.title: Topic Level 5
xdm:level5.description: The fifth-level (deepest) topic, a child of level4.
